purpose: Test an independent musical-context mechanism for the 54 V149 high-confidence singleton overrides without using Gold/reference or trying another evidence-margin threshold.

frozenContextDefinition.onsetOrdering: accepted family #10 onsets ordered by (measure, step)
frozenContextDefinition.targetPopulation: exactly the 54 event indices changed by V149 versus accepted family #10
frozenContextDefinition.neighborOnsets: immediately preceding and immediately following accepted onsets; neighbors may be singleton or polyphonic
frozenContextDefinition.distanceToNeighbor: minimum absolute MIDI semitone distance from target pitch to any note in that neighboring onset
frozenContextDefinition.originalCost: distance(original accepted MIDI, previous onset) + distance(original accepted MIDI, next onset)
frozenContextDefinition.selectedCost: distance(V149 selected MIDI, previous onset) + distance(V149 selected MIDI, next onset)
frozenContextDefinition.strictBothSidesWorse: selected distance is strictly greater than original distance for both previous and next onsets
frozenContextDefinition.strictBothSidesBetter: selected distance is strictly smaller than original distance for both previous and next onsets
frozenContextDefinition.localPitchClassWindow: two accepted onsets before and two accepted onsets after; count occurrences of original vs selected pitch class

outputs: counts and percentages for strict-both-sides-worse/better/mixed/tied context
counts and percentages for total voice-leading cost delta negative/zero/positive
pitch-class support comparison in the fixed +/-2-onset window
interpretationRule: This analysis is descriptive only. If strict-both-sides-worse cases exist, a later separately frozen candidate may conservatively revert exactly that set; no alternative contextual rule may be tried in the same phase.
